```{r import data}
#####################################
# PREPARE THE DATA
#####################################

# Clear the console and load packages
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))
library(rmarkdown)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(lsr)
options(scipen = 999, digits=3)

# Load function to tidy up data frames from raw data
tidydata <- function(Data) {
  
  Experiment <- deparse(substitute(Data))
  
# Tidy up the columns and make sure the columns are coded correctly
Data$Group <- as.character(Data$Experiment) # Whether participants received direct instruction - converted to factor in next block of code
Data$TestingGroup <- as.factor(Data$TestingGroup) # When participants were tested

# Include task component column (only relevant for OrthSearch)
if (Experiment == "OrthSearch"){
  Data$TaskComponent <- Data$Task
} else {
Data$TaskComponent <- NA
}

Data$Task <- as.factor(Data$ExperimentName) # Experimental task
Data$TaskComponent <- as.factor(Data$TaskComponent) # Task component (relevant for OrthSearch only)
Data$Script <- as.factor(Data$Language) # Georgian vs. Hungrarian script
Data$Subject <- as.character(Data$Subject) # Participant - changed to factor later in function
Data$Session <- as.numeric(Data$Session) # Testing day
Data$Trial <- as.numeric(Data$Trial) # Trial number within the task

if (Experiment == "SemQ"){
  Data$Orthography <- as.factor(Data$Target_Vis)
} else {
Data$Orthography <- as.factor(Data$Vis) # Orthographic form of stimulus
}

if (Experiment == "OrthSearch"){
  Data$Phonology <- as.factor(Data$Vis)
  Data$Phonology <- substring(Data$Phonology, 1, 3)
  Data$Phonology <- as.factor(Data$Phonology)
} else if (Experiment == "SemQ") {
  Data$Phonology <- as.character(Data$Target_Vis)
  Data$Phonology <- substring(Data$Phonology, 1, 3)
  Data$Phonology <- as.factor(Data$Phonology)
} else {
  Data$Phonology <- as.factor(Data$Aud) # Phonological form of stimulus
}

if (Experiment == "SemQ"){
  Data$Semantics <- as.factor(Data$Target_Sem)
} else {
Data$Semantics <- as.factor(Data$Sem) # Semantic meaning of stimulus
}

Data$SemanticMarker <- as.character(Data$Systematic) # Whether final symbol systematically denoted the semantic category - - converted to factor in next block of code
Data$Acc <- as.integer(Data$Acc) # Accuracy: 1 = Correct, 0 = Incorrect

# Relabel Group and systematicity factors with clearer names
Data$Group[Data$Group == "Exp2"] = "Discovery"
Data$Group[Data$Group == "Exp3"] = "Explicit"
Data$SemanticMarker[Data$SemanticMarker == "1"] = "Systematic"
Data$SemanticMarker[Data$SemanticMarker == "0"] = "Arbitrary"

# Relabel task with clearer names
Data$Task <- gsub("_.*$", "", as.character(Data$Task))
Data$Task <- as.factor(Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("OPRead", "2A. Reading Aloud", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("OSName", "2B. Saying the Meaning", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("OrthSearchBoth", "2C. Orthographic Search", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- gsub("SemQ", "2D. Meaning Judgment", Data$Task)
Data$Task <- as.character(Data$Task)
Data$Task <- factor(Data$Task, levels=c("2A. Reading Aloud", "2B. Saying the Meaning", "2C. Orthographic Search", "2D. Meaning Judgment"))

# Adjust Session labels for comparisons across Groups
Data$Adjustment <- Data$Group
Data$Adjustment[Data$Adjustment == "Discovery"] = "0"
Data$Adjustment[Data$Adjustment == "Explicit"] = "1"
Data$Session <- Data$Session + as.integer(Data$Adjustment)

# Tidy orthographic labels
Data$Orthography <- gsub("_G", "", Data$Orthography)
Data$Orthography <- gsub("_H", "", Data$Orthography)

# Convert Group and SemanticMarker for factors
Data$Group <- as.factor(Data$Group)
Data$SemanticMarker<- as.factor(Data$SemanticMarker)

# Keep only relevant columns
tidycolumns <- c("Group", "TestingGroup", "Task", "TaskComponent", "Script", "Subject", "Session", "Trial", "Orthography", "Phonology", "Semantics", "SemanticMarker", "Acc")
Data <- subset(Data, select = tidycolumns)

# Remove excluded participants
Data <- Data[Data$Subject != "317",] # Removed due to poor performance on final day tests
Data <- Data[Data$Subject != "318",] # Removed as did not complete the study past Session 1
Data$Subject <- as.factor(Data$Subject)

# Return tidied data frame
Data <- Data

}

# Load in the training data spreadsheets
OPRead <- read.csv("OrthographyTraining_ReadAloud.csv")
OSName <- read.csv("OrthographyTraining_SayTheMeaning.csv")
OrthSearch <- read.csv("OrthographyTraining_OrthographicSearch.csv")
SemQ <- read.csv("OrthographyTraining_SemanticCategorization.csv")

```


**Plots**  

``` {r training plot}

# Select data
Data <- rbind(tidydata(OPRead), tidydata(OSName), tidydata(OrthSearch), tidydata(SemQ))

#####################################
# CREATE TABLES OF MEANS
#####################################

# Subject accuracy
SubjectAcc <- Data %>%
  group_by(Group, Task, Subject, SemanticMarker, Session) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(subject_mean = mean(Acc),
            std_dev = sd(Acc),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(legend_label = paste0(Group, " ", SemanticMarker))


# Group accuracy
GroupAcc <- SubjectAcc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Group, Task, SemanticMarker, Session, legend_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(group_mean = mean(subject_mean),
            std_dev = sd(subject_mean),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))

GroupAcc$legend_label <- as.character(GroupAcc$legend_label)
GroupAcc$legend_label <- factor(GroupAcc$legend_label, levels=c("Explicit Systematic", "Explicit Arbitrary", "Discovery Systematic", "Discovery Arbitrary"))

# Specify chance performance for multiple choice tasks
Task <- c("2C. Orthographic Search", "2D. Meaning Judgment")
Chance <- c((1/24), 0.25)
chance_performance <- data.frame(Task, Chance)
chance_performance$Task <- as.factor(chance_performance$Task)

### INSTRUCTION TIME: CALCULATE MINIMUM NUMBER OF SESSIONS REQUIRED FOR 75% ACCURACY

# Mark which session participants scored 75% or higher
SubjectAcc_75 <- SubjectAcc %>%
  filter(SemanticMarker == "Systematic") %>% # Only include accuracy in systematic condition
  mutate(Criterion = case_when(subject_mean >= 0.75 ~ 1,
                               subject_mean < 0.75 ~ 0))

# Isolate participants that never reached 75% in a particular task and automatically assign their minimum session as 9 (the maximum number of sessions)
never_reached_criterion <- SubjectAcc_75 %>%
  group_by(Group, Task, SemanticMarker, Subject, legend_label) %>%
  summarize(max_score = max(Criterion)) %>%
  filter(max_score == 0) %>%
  mutate(min_session = 9)

# For participants that did reach 75%, calculate the first session in which they achieved this
SubjectAcc_75 <- SubjectAcc_75 %>%
  group_by(Group, Task, SemanticMarker, Subject, legend_label) %>%
  filter(Criterion == 1) %>%
  summarize(min_session = min(Session))

# Add the participants that never reached 75% back in
SubjectAcc_75 <- rbind(SubjectAcc_75, never_reached_criterion)

# Create group summaries for box plot
GroupAcc_75 <- SubjectAcc_75 %>%
  group_by(Group, Task, SemanticMarker, legend_label) %>%
  summarize(group_mean = mean(min_session),
            std_dev = sd(min_session),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))

#####################################
# CREATE PLOTS
#####################################

# Use the same theme for all plots
apatheme <- theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(4, "lines"),
        plot.title = element_text(face="bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 30)),
        legend.position = "right",
        axis.line.x = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color = 'black', size = 18),
        axis.text.x=element_text(color = 'black', size = 18),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=18),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=18, margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 0, l = 0)),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size=18),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face="bold", size = 20, margin = margin(b = 30)),
        strip.background = element_blank())

# Create panel plot for all training tasks
training_plot <- ggplot(GroupAcc, aes(x = Session, y = group_mean, group = legend_label))+
  geom_hline(data = chance_performance, aes(yintercept = Chance), color = "black", size = 1, linetype="dotted")+
  geom_line(aes(colour = legend_label, group = legend_label), linetype = "solid", size = 0.7)+
  geom_errorbar(data = GroupAcc, aes(x = Session, ymin = (group_mean - std_err), ymax = (group_mean + std_err), fill = legend_label, group = legend_label), size=0.2, width=0.5, position=position_dodge(0.5))+
  geom_point(aes(y= group_mean, colour = legend_label, group = legend_label), shape = 18, size = 4, position=position_dodge(0.5))+
  
  geom_jitter(data = SubjectAcc_75[SubjectAcc_75$legend_label == "Explicit Systematic",], aes(x = min_session, y = -0.175, fill = legend_label, colour= legend_label), size = 2, shape = 21, alpha = 0.5, height=0.03, width=0.3)+
  geom_tile(data = GroupAcc_75[GroupAcc_75$legend_label == "Explicit Systematic",], aes(x = group_mean, y = -0.175, width = (std_err * 2), height = 0.05, colour = legend_label, fill = legend_label, group = legend_label), size=0.2, alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_linerange(data=GroupAcc_75[GroupAcc_75$legend_label == "Explicit Systematic",], aes(x = group_mean, y = -0.175, group = legend_label, colour = legend_label), ymin = -0.21, ymax = -0.14, size = 1.5)+
  
  geom_jitter(data = SubjectAcc_75[SubjectAcc_75$legend_label == "Discovery Systematic",], aes(x = min_session, y = -0.075, fill = legend_label, colour= legend_label), size = 2, shape = 21, alpha = 0.5, height=0.03, width=0.3)+
  geom_tile(data = GroupAcc_75[GroupAcc_75$legend_label == "Discovery Systematic",], aes(x = group_mean, y = -0.075, width = (std_err * 2), height = 0.05, colour = legend_label, fill = legend_label, group = legend_label), size=0.2, alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_linerange(data=GroupAcc_75[GroupAcc_75$legend_label == "Discovery Systematic",], aes(x = group_mean, y = -0.075, group = legend_label, colour = legend_label), ymin = -0.11, ymax = -0.04, size = 1.5)+
  
  xlab("Session")+ylab("Proportion Accuracy")+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("#377EB8", "#AFCBE3", "#E41A1C", "#F4A3A4"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#377EB8", "#AFCBE3", "#E41A1C", "#F4A3A4"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.2, 1.0), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1:9))+
  coord_cartesian(clip = 'off')+
  facet_wrap(. ~ Task, nrow = 2, scale="free")+
  ggtitle("Training Tasks")+
  apatheme+
  annotate("segment", x=-Inf, xend=Inf, y=-Inf, yend=-Inf)+
  annotate("segment", x=-Inf, xend=-Inf, y=-Inf, yend=Inf)+
  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1),
        fill = guide_legend(order = 1), 
         alpha = guide_legend(order = 2))

# Add axes labels to all graphs in the panel
g <- ggplotGrob(training_plot)
g$grobs$axis_b1$children[[2]][["grobs"]][[2]] <- nullGrob()
g$grobs$axis_b2$children[[2]][["grobs"]][[2]] <- nullGrob()
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g)

print(training_plot)
```

<br>
``` {r t-tests}
# Conduct t-tests to check for between-group differences in instruction time

for (i in c(unique(as.character(SubjectAcc_75$Task)))){
  
 
  print(i)
  
  
  means_discovery <- SubjectAcc_75 %>%
   filter(Task == i,
          Group == "Discovery") 
  
  means_explicit <- SubjectAcc_75 %>%
   filter(Task == i,
          Group == "Explicit") 
  
  print(summary(means_discovery))
  print(summary(means_explicit))

instructiontime_test <-  t.test(means_discovery$min_session, means_explicit$min_session, paired = FALSE, var.equal = TRUE)

print(instructiontime_test)
print("t stat:") 
print(format(round(instructiontime_test$statistic, 2), nsmall = 2))
print("p value:") 
print(format(round(instructiontime_test$p.value, 3), nsmall = 3))

print("Cohen's D:")
print(cohensD(means_discovery$min_session, means_explicit$min_session))

}

```
**Training: Reading Aloud**  
``` {r reading aloud data}

#Select data
Data <- tidydata(OPRead)

```
``` {r reading aloud model, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results="hide"}

# Center continuous predictor variables prior to running model
Data$Session_centred <- Data$Session - mean(Data$Session)

# Run the accuracy model
acc_LME <- glmer(Acc ~ (Group * Session_centred) + (Group * SemanticMarker) + (1|Subject) + (1|Phonology) + (1|Semantics) + (1|Script), family=binomial, data = Data)

```
``` {r reading aloud model summary, include=TRUE}
tab_model(acc_LME, transform = NULL, dv.labels = "Accuracy", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Group", "Session", "Semantic Marker", "Group * Session", "Group * Semantic Marker"), show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, string.est = "Estimate", string.se = "SE", show.stat = TRUE)
tab_model(acc_LME, dv.labels = "Accuracy", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Group", "Session", "Semantic Marker", "Group * Session", "Group * Semantic Marker"), show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, string.se = "SE", show.stat = TRUE)
```

**Training: Orthographic Search**  
``` {r orthographic search data}

#Select data
Data <- tidydata(OrthSearch)

```
``` {r orthographic search model, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results="hide"}

# Center continuous predictor variables prior to running model
Data$Session_centred <- Data$Session - mean(Data$Session)

# Run the accuracy model
acc_LME <- glmer(Acc ~ (Group * Session_centred) + (Group * SemanticMarker) + (1|Subject) + (1|Phonology) + (1|Semantics) + (1|Script), family=binomial, data = Data)

acc_LME_withtaskcomponent <- glmer(Acc ~ (Group * Session_centred) + (Group * SemanticMarker) + (TaskComponent) + (1|Subject) + (1|Phonology) + (1|Semantics) + (1|Script), family=binomial, data = Data)

anova(acc_LME, acc_LME_withtaskcomponent)
summary(acc_LME_withtaskcomponent)

```
``` {r orthographic search model summary, include=TRUE}
tab_model(acc_LME, transform = NULL, dv.labels = "Accuracy", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Group", "Session", "Semantic Marker", "Group * Session", "Group * Semantic Marker"), show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, string.est = "Estimate", string.se = "SE", show.stat = TRUE)
tab_model(acc_LME, dv.labels = "Accuracy", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Group", "Session", "Semantic Marker", "Group * Session", "Group * Semantic Marker"), show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, string.se = "SE", show.stat = TRUE)
```
